claims.text: A 51-year-old man with generalized anxiety disorder, taking olanzapine 10 mg and lorazepam 1 mg at bedtime for three to four years, presented to the emergency department unconscious after an alleged ingestion of 10 tablets of olanzapine 10 mg about eight hours earlier. He had no history of diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, kidney disease or tuberculosis, and no smoking or alcohol use.
